2: 
3: The WebSocket and health HTTP endpoint share one TCP port.  The server has no
4: framework dependency: ``websockets`` handles both the upgrade and the small
5: HTTP response needed by ``/health``.
6: """
7: 
8: from __future__ import annotations
9: 
10: import asyncio
11: import json
12: import threading
13: import uuid
14: from datetime import datetime, timezone
15: from typing import Any
16: from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
17: 
18: from websockets.asyncio.server import ServerConnection, serve
19: from websockets.datastructures import Headers
20: from websockets.http11 import Request, Response
21: 
22: 
23: SUPPORTED_TYPES = {"broadcast", "direct", "system", "subscribe", "unsubscribe"}
24: 
25: 
26: def timestamp() -> str:
27:     """Return an unambiguous UTC timestamp for a message."""
28:     return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
29: 
30: 
31: class ClientRegistry:
32:     """Thread-safe mapping of generated client IDs to WebSocket connections."""
33: 
34:     def __init__(self) -> None:
35:         self._clients: dict[str, ServerConnection] = {}
36:         self._channels: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
37:         self._lock = threading.RLock()
38: 
39:     def add(self, connection: ServerConnection) -> str:
40:         client_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
41:         with self._lock:
42:             self._clients[client_id] = connection
43:         return client_id
44: 
45:     def remove(self, client_id: str) -> None:
46:         with self._lock:
47:             self._clients.pop(client_id, None)
48:             for channel in list(self._channels):
49:                 self._channels[channel].discard(client_id)
50:                 if not self._channels[channel]:
51:                     del self._channels[channel]
52: 
53:     def subscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
54:         with self._lock:
55:             self._channels.setdefault(channel, set()).add(client_id)
56: 
57:     def unsubscribe(self, client_id: str, channel: str) -> None:
58:         with self._lock:
59:             subscribers = self._channels.get(channel)
60:             if subscribers is None:
61:                 return
62:             subscribers.discard(client_id)
63:             if not subscribers:
64:                 del self._channels[channel]
65: 
66:     def channel_subscribers(self, channel: str) -> set[str]:
67:         with self._lock:
68:             return set(self._channels.get(channel, set()))
69: 
70:     def channels(self) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
71:         with self._lock:
72:             return {name: set(ids) for name, ids in self._channels.items()}
73: 
74:     def get(self, client_id: str) -> ServerConnection | None:
75:         with self._lock:
76:             return self._clients.get(client_id)
77: 
78:     def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, ServerConnection]:
79:         with self._lock:
80:             return dict(self._clients)
81: 
82:     @property
83:     def count(self) -> int:
84:         with self._lock:
85:             return len(self._clients)
86: 
87: 
88: def make_message(
89:     message_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any], channel: str | None = None
90: ) -> dict[str, Any]:
91:     if message_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES:
92:         raise ValueError(f"unsupported message type: {message_type}")
93:     message = {"type": message_type, "payload": payload, "timestamp": timestamp()}
94:     if channel is not None:
95:         message["channel"] = channel
96:     return message
97: 
98: 
99: class NotificationServer:
100:     """WebSocket notification server with broadcast and direct delivery."""
101: 
102:     def __init__(self, host: str = "localhost", port: int = 8765) -> None:
103:         self.host = host
104:         self.port = port
105:         self.registry = ClientRegistry()
106:         self._server: Any = None
107: 
108:     async def start(self) -> None:
109:         self._server = await serve(
110:             self._handle_connection,
111:             self.host,
112:             self.port,
113:             process_request=self._process_request,
114:         )
115:         if self._server.sockets:
116:             self.port = self._server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
117: 
118:     async def stop(self) -> None:
119:         if self._server is not None:
120:             self._server.close()
121:             await self._server.wait_closed()
122:             self._server = None
123: 
124:     async def _process_request(
125:         self, connection: ServerConnection, request: Request
126:     ) -> Response | None:
127:         path = urlsplit(request.path).path
128:         body_data: dict[str, Any] | None = None
129:         if path == "/health":
130:             body_data = {"status": "ok", "clients": self.registry.count}
131:         elif path == "/channels":
132:             body_data = {
133:                 "channels": [
134:                     {"name": name, "subscribers": len(subscribers)}
135:                     for name, subscribers in sorted(self.registry.channels().items())
136:                 ]
137:             }
138:         elif path.startswith("/channels/") and path.endswith("/subscribers"):
139:             channel = unquote(path[len("/channels/") : -len("/subscribers")]).strip("/")
140:             if not channel:
141:                 return None
142:             body_data = {
143:                 "channel": channel,
144:                 "subscribers": sorted(self.registry.channel_subscribers(channel)),
145:             }
146:         else:
147:             return None
148:         body = json.dumps(body_data).encode()
149:         return Response(
150:             200,
151:             "OK",
152:             Headers(
153:                 {
154:                     "Content-Type": "application/json",
155:                     "Content-Length": str(len(body)),
156:                 }
157:             ),
158:             body,
159:         )
160: 
161:     async def _handle_connection(self, connection: ServerConnection) -> None:
162:         client_id = self.registry.add(connection)
163:         try:
164:             await connection.send(
165:                 json.dumps(make_message("system", {"event": "connected", "client_id": client_id}))
166:             )
167:             async for raw_message in connection:
168:                 await self._handle_message(client_id, raw_message)
169:         finally:
170:             self.registry.remove(client_id)
171: 
172:     async def _handle_message(self, sender_id: str, raw_message: str) -> None:
173:         try:
174:             message = json.loads(raw_message)
175:             if not isinstance(message, dict):
176:                 raise ValueError
177:             message_type = message.get("type")
178:             payload = message.get("payload")
179:             if message_type in {"subscribe", "unsubscribe"} and payload is None:
180:                 payload = {}
181:             if message_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES or not isinstance(payload, dict):
182:                 raise ValueError
183:             channel = message.get("channel")
184:             if channel is None:
185:                 channel = payload.get("channel")
186:             if channel is not None and (
187:                 not isinstance(channel, str) or not channel.strip()
188:             ):
189:                 raise ValueError
190:             if message_type in {"subscribe", "unsubscribe"} and channel is None:
191:                 raise ValueError
192:         except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
193:             sender = self.registry.get(sender_id)
194:             if sender is not None:
195:                 await sender.send(json.dumps(make_message("system", {"error": "invalid message"})))
196:             return
197: 
198:         channel = channel.strip() if isinstance(channel, str) else None
199:         if message_type == "subscribe":
200:             self.registry.subscribe(sender_id, channel)
201:             await self._send_control(sender_id, "subscribed", channel)
202:         elif message_type == "unsubscribe":
203:             self.registry.unsubscribe(sender_id, channel)
204:             await self._send_control(sender_id, "unsubscribed", channel)
205:         else:
206:             outgoing = make_message(message_type, payload, channel)
207:             if message_type == "broadcast":
208:                 await self.broadcast(outgoing, channel)
209:             elif message_type == "direct":
210:                 target_id = payload.get("client_id") or payload.get("recipient")
211:                 target = self.registry.get(target_id) if isinstance(target_id, str) else None
212:                 if target is not None and (
213:                     channel is None
214:                     or target_id in self.registry.channel_subscribers(channel)
215:                 ):
216:                     await target.send(json.dumps(outgoing))
217:             else:
218:                 # System messages are server-generated; clients may send them only
219:                 # to themselves, which keeps the message contract predictable.
220:                 sender = self.registry.get(sender_id)
221:                 if sender is not None and (
222:                     channel is None
223:                     or sender_id in self.registry.channel_subscribers(channel)
224:                 ):
225:                     await sender.send(json.dumps(outgoing))
226: 
227:     async def _send_control(self, client_id: str, event: str, channel: str) -> None:
228:         client = self.registry.get(client_id)
229:         if client is not None:
230:             await client.send(
231:                 json.dumps(make_message("system", {"event": event, "channel": channel}))
232:             )
233: 
234:     async def broadcast(self, message: dict[str, Any], channel: str | None = None) -> None:
235:         encoded = json.dumps(message)
236:         clients = self.registry.snapshot()
237:         if channel is not None:
238:             clients = {
239:                 client_id: connection
240:                 for client_id, connection in clients.items()
241:                 if client_id in self.registry.channel_subscribers(channel)
242:             }
243:         connections = clients.values()
244:         if connections:
245:             await asyncio.gather(*(connection.send(encoded) for connection in connections), return_exceptions=True)
246: 
247: 
248: async def run_server(host: str = "localhost", port: int = 8765) -> None:
249:     server = NotificationServer(host, port)
250:     await server.start()
251:     try:
252:         await asyncio.Future()
253:     finally:
254:         await server.stop()
255: 
256: 
257: if __name__ == "__main__":
258:     asyncio.run(run_server())

import asyncio
import json
from urllib.request import urlopen

import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from websockets.asyncio.client import connect

from app import NotificationServer


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def server():
    instance = NotificationServer("127.0.0.1", 0)
    await instance.start()
    yield instance
    await instance.stop()


async def receive_json(client):
    return json.loads(await client.recv())


async def wait_for_count(server, expected):
    for _ in range(20):
        if server.registry.count == expected:
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    assert server.registry.count == expected


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_clients_receive_unique_ids_and_health_count(server):
    async with connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as first:
        first_system = await receive_json(first)
        async with connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as second:
            second_system = await receive_json(second)
            assert first_system["type"] == second_system["type"] == "system"
            assert first_system["payload"]["client_id"] != second_system["payload"]["client_id"]
            assert server.registry.count == 2
            response = await asyncio.to_thread(
                urlopen, f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.port}/health"
            )
            assert json.loads(response.read()) == {"status": "ok", "clients": 2}
        await wait_for_count(server, 1)
    await wait_for_count(server, 0)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_broadcast_reaches_all_clients(server):
    async with (
        connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as first,
        connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as second,
    ):
        await first.recv()
        await second.recv()
        message = {"type": "broadcast", "payload": {"text": "hello"}}
        await first.send(json.dumps(message))
        received = await asyncio.gather(receive_json(first), receive_json(second))
        assert [item["payload"] for item in received] == [{"text": "hello"}] * 2
        assert all(item["type"] == "broadcast" and item["timestamp"] for item in received)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_direct_message_targets_one_client(server):
    async with (
        connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as first,
        connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as second,
    ):
        await first.recv()
        second_id = (await receive_json(second))["payload"]["client_id"]
        await first.send(json.dumps({"type": "direct", "payload": {"client_id": second_id, "text": "private"}}))
        received = await receive_json(second)
        assert received["type"] == "direct"
        assert received["payload"]["text"] == "private"
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
            await asyncio.wait_for(first.recv(), timeout=0.05)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_invalid_message_returns_system_error(server):
    async with connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as client:
        await client.recv()
        await client.send("not json")
        error = await receive_json(client)
        assert error["type"] == "system"
        assert error["payload"] == {"error": "invalid message"}


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_channel_broadcast_reaches_only_subscribers(server):
    async with (
        connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as alerts,
        connect(f"ws://127.0.0.1:{server.port}") as other,
    ):
        await alerts.recv()
        await other.recv()
        await alerts.send(json.dumps({"type": "subscribe", "payload": {"channel": "alerts"}}))
        confirmation = await receive_json(alerts)
        assert confirmation["payload"] == {"event": "subscribed", "channel": "alerts"}

        await other.send(json.dumps({
            "type": "broadcast",
            "channel": "alerts",
            "payload": {"text": "warning"},
        }))
        received = await receive_json(alerts)
        assert received["channel"] == "alerts"
        assert received["payload"] == {"text": "warning"}
